answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 32077 Country: India Title: My question is that if a person does masterbation in the night during Ramadhan and does not take gusl immediately. Question: My question is that if a person does masterbation in the night during Ramadhan and does not take gusl immediately. he sleeps with the intention of roza but does not get up in sehri and also misses fajr salah.But he keeps roza and take gusl after getting up like 9 o clock in the morning. Will his roza be valid or what is the ruling regarding this?? Answer ID: 32077 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 812/675/B=1432) His sawm shall be valid in that state too. However, it is makrooh to remain impure for so long. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
